_comment: Mergify merge windows (America/New_York). Source of truth for Ops Controls display and for regenerating .mergify.yml schedule conditions via scripts/lib/mergify_windows.py. Market freeze Mon–Fri 09:30–16:15 ET is hard — presets must never open that band. Changed by reviewed PR (or Ops Controls preset → regenerate → PR).

after_hours.label: After hours (trial)
after_hours.description: Any time outside market hours Mon–Fri 09:30–16:15 ET, plus all weekend. For the Mergify trial.

narrow_four.label: Narrow (four slots)
narrow_four.description: Legacy four short windows (evening, midnight, morning, pre-open).

weekends_only.label: Weekends only
weekends_only.description: Sat–Sun all day; no weekday merges.
